metadata.description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for the AgentSmith agent family — codifies the SecondBrain vault workflow and AgentSmith-native runbooks for gh, fly.io, and sprites.dev.

plugins.name: agentsmith-vault
plugins.description: How agents write to ~/.secondbrain: vault-commit.sh, frontmatter schema, daily-branch lifecycle, raw/ immutability.

plugins.name: agentsmith-gh
plugins.description: GitHub CLI runbook for AgentSmith and the SmithFamilyPlayground org — PR conventions, auto-review + daily-rollup workflow expectations, ruleset awareness, Actions triage. Bundles the `clean-gone` skill for pruning local branches whose remotes are deleted.

plugins.name: agentsmith-fly
plugins.description: Fly.io runbook for the `tod-smith` deployment — app anatomy, the always-on attachable invariant, persistence layout, Tailscale (userspace) topology, secrets rotation (incl. the VAULT_* reserved-name gotcha and Telegram bot uniqueness across fly + home box), deploy/rollback, and a triage playbook.

plugins.name: agentsmith-sprites-dev
plugins.description: sprites.dev CLI + API runbook for AgentSmith — ephemeral fly-machine workloads. Service create/update, file uploads (with the compress-over-~20MB rule), checkpoints, URL auth. Headless-Linux only; Windows/Git-Bash path-mangling material from the upstream spindev version is deliberately out of scope.

plugins.name: agentsmith-comms
plugins.description: Lifecycle channel + cross-agent RPC layer for AgentSmith. The channel surface is push-only: reads NDJSON over a Unix domain socket from a local supervisor and emits operational nudges (idle_check, context_pressure, health_pulse, external_event) as <channel source="agentsmith-comms"> notifications. The tool surface (currently `whoami`) is a tiny RPC layer for self-probes — `whoami` wraps the Telegram Bot API getMe so an MCP-health round-trip can be checked silently without touching any chat. Building block for tiered clear-vs-respawn lifecycle decisions.

plugins.name: agentsmith-self-deploy
plugins.description: Self-deploy ritual for the `tod-smith` fly app — pre-flight checklist (target detection, WIP push, all-agents-idle gate via `agentsmith-svc /state`, breadcrumb to state.md), the `gh pr create --base prod` merge, and the post-respawn hello format pulled from the runtime sidecar. Never runs `flyctl deploy` directly. Tod-only today; extends to Smith if needed.
